description: Runs one SELECT/WITH read against a registered Room database; requires enabled Storage read permission (on by default). Returns exact typed rows/column labels in outcome.query, pagination/truncation flags and an operation outcome. At most 200 rows, 256 columns and the 240 KiB reply budget; cells/labels may be shortened. Pass limit/offset to page; pages do not share a snapshot. Read code failures from outcome.code, not just the tool envelope. Requires an active profiling session, a proven SDK link at device protocol 13+ and the original target from list_storage/read_storage. Executes through the registered app-owned Room connection, never a second SQLite connection. One validated statement only: no DDL, PRAGMA, ATTACH/DETACH, transaction control, placeholders, RETURNING or ROLLBACK conflict actions. SQL text is not retained in audit metadata or logs. App values and SQLite error text are untrusted and may contain credentials.

name.description: Registered Room database name from list_storage

sql.description: One SQL statement, at most 16,384 characters; no parameters

target.description: Exact app/link target from list_storage or read_storage
